entries.source:
Shatter the spacetime continuum around yourself, inflicting %0.2f temporal damage to all targets within radius %d. Any atrophy stacks will be consumed to steal time from your victims, inflicting an additional %0.2f temporal damage and granting you %d%% of a turn per stack (but no more than 3 turns).
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
打破时空连续性，对 %d 格内所有敌人造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。同时，衰亡层数将被消耗以窃取目标的时间，每层造成额外 %0.2f 时空伤害，并使你获得 %d%% 回合（最多获得 3 回合）。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Self destruct in a glorious explosion of gore dealing %0.2f blight damage to all enemies in %d radius.  Your summoner must be dead to use this talent.
entries.target: 自爆成一团光荣的血肉，对半径 %d 格范围内的所有敌人造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。这个技能只有主人死亡时能够使用。
